summary: This bill requires the Interior Secretary to reissue within 60 days its 2020 rule removing gray wolves from Endangered Species Act protections and bars judicial review of that action.

scores.thoughts: The bill mandates a regulatory action under the Endangered Species Act but contains no provisions related to federal spending, appropriations, or budget changes.
The bill contains no tax-related provisions or changes to tax policy.
The bill has no connection to healthcare policy or systems.
The bill does not address firearms, gun regulations, or Second Amendment issues.
The bill has no provisions related to immigration, borders, or citizenship.
The bill does not address reproductive rights or abortion access.
The bill contains no military, defense, or national security spending provisions.

The bill requires the delisting of gray wolves from Endangered Species Act protections and shields the action from judicial review. This directly weakens federal environmental/wildlife regulations in favor of reduced restrictions.
